title: I Used the Archive-Reading-Room Camera Through Three Request Days After They Cut the Slot

parts.text: Day one they cut the request slot and posted a camera that faced only inbound carts. I was forty-five, researcher, holding a call slip that still needed a slot. At 10:18 a.m. the camera watched inbound and, I found, not the table where folders sat unattended. Temporary, the archivist said. I photographed the cut slot, the table, the time. Then a tote I did not recognize used the table toward the stair. I kept my voice indoor and let the timestamp talk. A paper policy is only paper until someone treats it like a clock.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: An unrecognized tote just used the folder table toward the stair.

social.video_title: They cut the request slot and aimed the camera inbound — Part 1/3
social.description: Call slip, a blind table, a tote toward the stair. Would you have followed the tote?

parts.text: Day two I followed with the stills. The stair cam (there was none) did not take the tote. The person palmed folders that were not inbound I could see from the reading-room cone. I was still forty-five, still the file. I messaged special collections the table still and stayed in the cone. The person looked at the cone, then at the last unlocked map drawer. I did not chase. I carbon-copied. I have learned the difference between a title and a line item.
parts.cliffhanger_hint: They are at the map drawers; special collections now has the still.

social.video_title: The tote went to a stair with no camera — Part 2/3
social.description: Folders off-inbound, a reading-room cone, unlocked maps next. Special collections has the still. Do you stay in the cone?

parts.text: Special collections locked the map row from the office. The person left the tote and the folders. Morning recoded the camera to the table and restored the slot. The archivist who called it temporary lost the cut. I keep a call-slip receipt. Cameras watch tables now, not vibes. The room at 10:18 sounds like a reading room, which is to say paper and nobody's tote. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point. If it is written, it can be applied to the person who wrote it.

social.video_title: Morning aimed the camera at the table — Part 3/3
social.description: Restored slot, a lost cut, cameras on the table. Was temporary ever a stair?
